name: Audio Analysis
author: DSP Toolbox
description: Measurement tools: pitch, onsets, MFCC, spectral features and a whole-file report.

paramHelp.threshold: How sure the pitch tracker must be before it calls a frame voiced. Lower is stricter.
paramHelp.a4_hz: The reference for note names and cents. Most music uses 440 Hz.
paramHelp.sensitivity: Higher finds quieter onsets, and more false ones.
paramHelp.min_interval_ms: Two onsets closer than this count as one.
paramHelp.skip_c0: Coefficient 0 mostly follows the level, and its size would hide the others.
paramHelp.show_rolloff: The frequency below which 85 % of the sound's magnitude lies.
